question: The length of each diagonal of a rectangle is 50 cm. If its breadth is 14 cm, then what will be the area of the rectangle?
solution:
**Given:**

The length of each diagonal of a rectangle is 50 cm

The breadth of rectangle is 14 cm

**Formula Used:** 

Pythagorean theorem: (hypotenuse)²=(Base)²+(height)²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Diagonal = hypotenuse = 50 cm

⇒ Breadth = Base = b = 14 cm

⇒ Length = height = l

According to the Pythagorean theorem

⇒ (hypotenuse)²=(Base)²+(height)² 

⇒ (diagonal)²=(breadth)²+(length)²

⇒ 50²=14²+(length)²

⇒ (length)²=50²-14²

⇒ length=sqrt{(2500-196)}=sqrt{2304}=48

⇒ Area of the rectangle =lengthtimes breadth=48 cm×14 cm=672 cm²

**Hence, ****The area of the rectangle is 672 cm²**
